field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_RESULTMATRIX_REQUEST_PROJECT_LABEL
field.query: SELECT p.id AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name,''),CONCAT('ID ',p.id)) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project AS p WHERE p.published=1 ORDER BY p.name,p.id

field.name: stage_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_RESULTMATRIX_REQUEST_STAGE_LABEL
field.query: SELECT s.id AS value, CONCAT(p.name,' - ',s.name) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project_stage AS s INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project AS p ON p.id=s.project_id AND p.published=1 WHERE s.published=1 ORDER BY p.name,s.sequence_number,s.id
